registered_by: Maintainer (Joel Dietz) with Cursor agent; spec in docs/LINEAR_TYPE_EXTENSION_SPEC.md
discipline: Separate registration artifact. The locked predictions/prediction_registry.json is NOT edited. Each prediction below is a delphi:TestableHypothesis with a prior probability fixed BEFORE any of the proposed work beyond the prototype morphoeval/lean/LinearResource.lean was attempted. Priors are the registrant's subjective credence that the stated outcome will be achieved by the stated deadline using the linear-resource DSL in Lean 4 plus the proposed Project Delphi ontology terms; they are NOT probabilities that the underlying biology is true. Resolution: a later nanopublication per prediction citing the resolving commit, with outcome_verdict in {confirmed, refuted, unresolved-at-deadline}. No prior is edited after this file is committed; corrections are new registrations.

prototype.status: kernel-checked, 0 sorry, no additional axioms, at the registering commit

baseline_snapshot.note: The 3,000 overnight template stubs recorded in morphoeval/problem_scouts/lean_stub_census.json (issue #268) have since been deleted; all 136 remaining loop files are mechanism-specific. 'Re-formalised' below therefore means replacing an existing equational Int identity with a DSL instantiation, not replacing a stub.

shared_definitions.DSL_instantiation: A Lean declaration in a morphoeval/lean module whose conservation statement is obtained by applying MathOfBiology.Linear.conserves (or a theorem that is itself derived from it) to a MathOfBiology.Linear.Prog built from the loop's governing law, rather than by a free-standing arithmetic identity.
shared_definitions.cross_check: A Python or Lean harness that runs the DSL-typed stepper and the existing repo reference implementation from identical initial conditions and compares the conserved total (or type-count multiset) at every step.
shared_definitions.conservation_violation: A relative drift |total_t - total_0| / max(1, |total_0|) > 1e-9 in a reference Python implementation at any step, including boundary nodes/cells, under the implementation's own default parameters.

predictions.title: Linear-resource DSL soundness in core Lean 4
predictions.statement: A core-Lean (no Mathlib) linear-resource DSL whose only constructors are skip/transfer/seq, with a once-proved soundness theorem that every well-scoped program preserves the ledger total, is merged to main and kernel-checks with 0 sorry and no additional axioms.
predictions.proposed_test: lean morphoeval/lean/LinearResource.lean exits 0; `#print axioms MathOfBiology.Linear.conserves` lists only propext/Quot.sound/Classical.choice or fewer; file present on main.
predictions.falsifier: Module absent from main, or kernel rejects it, or it depends on sorry/extra axioms.
predictions.basis: Prototype already compiles locally at registration time; residual risk is only merge/CI.

predictions.title: Auxin canalization class re-formalised as DSL instantiations
predictions.statement: All five auxin canalization loops (Loop_032 auxin_pin1_phyllotaxis, Loop_034 auxin_canalization_leaf_veins, Loop_035 carrier_driven_canalization, Loop_038 root_auxin_reflux_fountain, Loop_0401 mus_musculus_flux_canalization) each carry at least one law whose conservation theorem is a DSL instantiation, and morphoeval/check_lean_formula_alignment.py passes on the paired math_kg_loops YAML.
predictions.proposed_test: Grep each listed .lean for a theorem whose proof term applies MathOfBiology.Linear.conserves; run check_lean_formula_alignment.py on each YAML; both must pass for all five.
predictions.falsifier: Any of the five lacks a DSL instantiation at the deadline, or the alignment checker fails for it.
predictions.basis: Loop_032 L64 (jonsson_2006_intercellular_flux_conservation) and Loop_034 L98 (feugier_2005_polar_flux_conservation) are already edge-flux antisymmetry identities; the prototype instantiates Loop_032 directly. Loop_038 (reflux fountain, 2-D tissue with boundary) is the hardest.

predictions.title: Cell-sorting swap moves conserve the type multiset by typing
predictions.statement: A Potts/GGH swap-move stepper is expressed in the DSL (or a uniqueness-typed Lean engine) so that cell-type-count conservation for arbitrary move sequences is a corollary of the soundness theorem, and a cross-check against models/1992-graner-cellular-potts-cell-sorting.py shows identical type counts over at least 1,000 Monte Carlo steps.
predictions.proposed_test: Cross-check harness committed under morphoeval/; report identical per-type counts at every MCS; Lean theorem present and kernel-checked.
predictions.falsifier: No kernel-checked swap stepper by the deadline, or cross-check diverges.
predictions.basis: Swap = two transfers of one unit between label ledgers; the DSL covers it. Risk is engineering the lattice/neighbourhood bookkeeping in core Lean and matching the Python RNG stream.

predictions.title: Somitogenesis counting laws derived from one PSM consumption law
predictions.statement: A single typed consumption law (PSM cells consumed by the wavefront at rate v, partitioned by the clock period T) is formalised in the DSL, and both dubrulle_2001_fgf8_bead_somite_pair_conservation (Loop_024 L83) and meinhardt_1986_half_somite_cleft_count (Loop_021 L154) are re-derived as corollaries of it.
predictions.proposed_test: Both named theorems' statements are proved from a shared Linear.Prog instance plus the existing arithmetic, with no free-standing restatement of the counting identity.
predictions.falsifier: Either theorem still requires its own arithmetic identity unrelated to the consumption program at the deadline.
predictions.basis: The biology is a budget; the open question is whether the clock partition (period, not quantity) fits a quantity-ledger without a graded extension of the DSL.

predictions.title: A conservation violation exists in at least one current reference implementation
predictions.statement: When the DSL-typed stepper is cross-checked against the repo's own Python reference implementations for Physarum (models/2010-tero-physarum-transport-network.py), auxin canalization (models/1997-mitchison-canalization-auxin-flux.py, models/2006-jonsson-auxin-pin1-meristem.py, models/2005-feugier-carrier-driven-canalization.py) and Potts sorting (models/1992-graner-cellular-potts-cell-sorting.py), at least one of these implementations exhibits a conservation_violation as defined above, most likely at boundary nodes or in source/sink handling.
predictions.proposed_test: Run each reference implementation with default parameters, log the conserved total per step, apply the 1e-9 relative-drift threshold; publish the per-model drift table.
predictions.falsifier: All five implementations hold the total to within 1e-9 relative drift at every step.
predictions.basis: Not inspected before registration. Open-boundary Physarum and reflux models commonly leak at sources/sinks by construction; Potts swaps are exact by design. The prediction is the operational payoff of the extension: it should find something.

predictions.title: Gap-junction charge transfer formalised as a linear transfer
predictions.statement: The planarian H+/K+-ATPase and bioelectric loops get a DSL instantiation in which ion flux through a gap junction is a transfer between cell ledgers, so that total charge conservation across the gap-junction network is a corollary of the soundness theorem, with gj_voltage_gate_symmetry_and_isolation (Loop_081 L61) re-expressed as a property of the transfer amount.
predictions.proposed_test: Kernel-checked instantiation present; cross-check against models/2011-beane-planarian-hk-atpase-anterior.py total-charge trace.
predictions.falsifier: No instantiation by deadline, or the continuous Vmem dynamics cannot be matched by an integer/rational ledger within the cross-check tolerance.
predictions.basis: Transfer shape is identical to auxin, but the reference model is a continuous ODE in Vmem, not an explicit charge ledger; the ledger would need a rational or fixed-point carrier and a documented discretisation.

predictions.title: Project Delphi adopts an additive proof-kind term
predictions.statement: fractastical/project-delphi-ontology releases a minor version (2.x) that adds a term equivalent to delphi:proofKind (controlled values including 'equational', 'conservation-by-typing', 'executable') and a toolchain-version term, and at least one signed nanopublication published to the production network uses them.
predictions.proposed_test: delphi.ttl on main declares the terms; a nanopub resolvable at a w3id.org/np/ trusty URI uses them.
predictions.falsifier: No such release, or released but unused in any published nanopub, by the deadline.
predictions.basis: Additive and backward compatible, and the ontology's own editorialNote on delphi:leanVerified already asks for the toolchain. Risk is review bandwidth, not design.

predictions.title: Share of the morphoeval loop corpus that is a conservation/partition law
predictions.statement: Of the 136 mechanism-specific Lean loop files, at least 40 contain at least one law expressible as a DSL instantiation without any additional arithmetic theorem beyond the soundness theorem, and at least 20 of those are actually re-formalised and emitted into the MorphoEval KG with proofKind 'conservation-by-typing'.
predictions.proposed_test: A committed audit (extension of morphoeval/audit_lean_proofs.py) classifies every loop's laws; count of 'DSL-expressible' >= 40 and count of emitted 'conservation-by-typing' nodes >= 20.
predictions.falsifier: Either count below threshold at the deadline.
predictions.basis: By loop name, roughly 35-45 loops are flux/partition/budget laws (auxin x5, sorting x5, somite x6, branching/transport x8, bioelectric x4, counting laws in feather/digit/ruga loops). The 20-emitted half is a labour prediction.

predictions.title: Negative control: elasticity and Turing-wavelength laws are NOT DSL-expressible
predictions.statement: For the elastic-buckling and Turing-wavelength loop classes (e.g. Loop_094 bacillus_biofilm_wrinkling, Loop_0101 mus_musculus_turing_wavelength, cortical_gyrification_folding, venus_flytrap_snap_buckling, mollusc_shell_marginal_buckling), zero laws are expressible as DSL instantiations without an additional arithmetic theorem, so their KG proofKind remains 'equational'.
predictions.proposed_test: Same audit as LT-08; the listed loops must be classified 'equational-only'.
predictions.falsifier: Any listed loop acquires a genuine DSL instantiation (not a trivially wrapped identity).
predictions.basis: These laws are dispersion relations and scaling exponents, not conservation statements. Registering this bounds the extension's claimed scope.

predictions.title: Rule 30 left-bijectivity as a linear isomorphism in a uniqueness-typed stepper
predictions.statement: A Lean CA stepper for Rule 30 is written so that the left-argument update is a typed bijection, and the backward reconstruction theorems (MathOfBiology.jen_1990_left_bijective L48, quadrant_pde_bwd_m0/m1 L72-78 and their inverse theorems) are obtained as the inverse direction of that typed map rather than by separate cases-rfl proofs; the stepper cross-checks bit-for-bit against models/1984-wolfram-conus-textile-rule30.py for 1,024 steps.
predictions.proposed_test: Kernel-checked module where the inverse theorems are projections of an Equiv/bijection structure; bit-identical centre column for 1,024 steps (compare to R30-OEIS-128-01 fixture).
predictions.falsifier: Inverse theorems still proved independently, or cross-check mismatch.
predictions.basis: The mathematics is settled (Jen 1990); the uncertainty is whether core Lean without Mathlib's Equiv makes the bijection packaging worth it.
